messages.text: Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Overcast Skies for Friday Evening
An overcast but mild Friday evening is set for a full moon. Locally, the Ann Arbor District Library is celebrating Dolly Parton, while nearby Detroit offers a free film screening.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 68°F and a low around 45°F; there is a 1% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:25 AM, sunset at 7:26 PM, and the moon is full and 97.6% illuminated.
Evening Gatherings and Celebrations

For a free community event, the Windsor International Film Festival is showing "Best in Show" at Campus Martius Park in Detroit at 7:00 PM. In Ann Arbor, the District Library hosts "Dolly Day" with crafts and music videos starting at 5:30 PM.
The next notable calendar item is the Autumn equilux, occurring tomorrow at 12:27 AM.
Ann Arbor Plans Spending for Downtown Lot Sale Funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the expected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the Kline's lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Tomorrow Offers Cultural and Musical Events

Tomorrow, Ypsilanti kicks off "The Big Read" at the Michigan Library Plaza at 11:00 AM with performances and speakers. The Ark in Ann Arbor features multiple musical acts throughout the evening, including Devon Gilfillian at 8:00 PM.
Satellites Navigate Without GPS, Roman Telescope Prepares for Launch

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and object catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review and is preparing for launch.
The next Starship launch is estimated to be no earlier than September 18, 2026, according to independent listings.
Find a quiet moment to appreciate the turning of the season.
Saturday, September 26 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Clear Autumn Skies

A clear and warm autumn day offers a chance to enjoy the full moon tonight. Locally, attention turns to Ann Arbor's plans for downtown development funds, while science news highlights advancements in cancer treatment research.
Today will be mostly clear with a high near 72°F and a low around 46°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:26 AM, sunset at 7:24 PM, and tonight features a full moon, 99.7% illuminated.
Arts and Culture Around Town

In Ann Arbor, The Ark presents The Bros. Landreth at 7:30 PM for a Roots/Americana/Alt-Country performance. For a free option, the Ypsilanti community can attend the 'MARIPOSA/BUTTERFLY: SPINNING DOT THEATRE' play at YDL-Whittaker at 2:00 PM.
Mark your calendar for September 30, which is both My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor's Downtown Development Fund Allocation

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the expected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy initiatives.
Looking Ahead: Music and Comedy

Tomorrow, catch the Jazz Fest at The Ravens Club in Ann Arbor, starting at 2:00 PM with free admission. In Detroit, Colin Mochrie & Brad Sherwood from 'Who's Line Is It Anyway?' perform at Sound Board at MotorCity Casino Hotel at 7:30 PM.
Soundwave Cancer Treatments and Autonomous Navigation

The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves. NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects.
SpaceX's Starship launch schedule is unset, with no official date for the next attempt listed.
May the quiet hours offer a chance for reflection and discovery.
